fever_roberta_binary.description: FEVER binary fact verification with RoBERTa. Accuracy is the primary reasoning metric; loss measures uncertainty; MHA compression ratio is the constraint/efficiency metric for the modified layer.

accuracy.description: Headline binary fact-verification accuracy on the FEVER artifact predictions.

balanced_accuracy.description: Macro-average recall across the true and false labels, catching methods that improve by favoring one class.

loss.description: Mean negative log likelihood reported for the gold label, used as a secondary uncertainty metric.

prediction_distribution_shift.description: Total variation distance between predicted-label and gold-label distributions, scaled to percentage points to penalize degenerate class collapse.

mha_compression_ratio.description: Ratio of original dense MHA parameters to compressed MHA parameters for the modified layer.
